one_liner: Glow_Dust creates an additive particle field with a configurable texture, speed, size, and emissive properties.
primary_use_case: Add glowy dust particle effects to scenes, useful for ambience, magical effects, or visual flair.
preview_recommendation: Use the attached mp4 preview to evaluate particle visual quality and ensure the texture asset loads correctly for optimal effect.
manifest_quality_notes: Additive blending may impact performance on low‑end devices
